tools.description: Cross-platform package manager for Python and R ecosystems, fully self-contained executable
tools.usage:
conda create -n myenv python=3.11 # Create environment
conda install numpy pandas # Install packages
conda list # Show installed packages
conda env list # List environments

tools.description: Fast, lightweight conda-compatible package manager with minimal dependencies
tools.usage:
micromamba create -n myenv python=3.11 # Create environment
micromamba install -n myenv numpy # Install to specific env
micromamba activate myenv # Activate environment
micromamba info # Show configuration
